out_of_scope.reason: CAPD (Cornell Assessment of Pediatric Delirium) documented in a note (section 5, A29); patient age 65 is in scope by age

evidence.role: CAPD assessment recorded in a note
evidence.quote: the Cornell Assessment of Pediatric Delirium (CAPD) was completed at bedside at 14:00, total score 5

onset.difference_note: out of scope: no section 7 category

max_grade.difference_note: out of scope: no section 7 category

derivation.onset: Section 5: any note containing a CAPD assessment makes the case out of scope (A29), whatever the patient's age; no section 7 category is assigned.
derivation.max_grade: Same CAPD trigger (section 5, A29); no category for the grade field.

ambiguity_notes: The CAPD was done in a unit delirium-screening pilot on a 65-year-old; the rule has no exception for adult patients or for the reason it was used, so the trigger applies as written. Other notes (ICE 8 on Day +5, ICE 5 on Day +7) would otherwise support onset and grade, but are not graded.
